# National Academic Digital Library of Ethiopia

> > Ethiopia's comprehensive open educational repository connecting academic institutions, vocational training, and global learning platforms through a unified digital library system.

NADL Ethiopia serves as a national hub for academic and vocational educational resources, integrating institutional repositories with partnerships from leading global platforms like MIT OpenCourseWare, EdX, and Microsoft. The platform supports diverse learners from K-12 through postgraduate levels across STEM, health sciences, hospitality, and technical vocational education.

## Core Platform

- [Homepage](https://ndl.ethernet.edu.et): Main entry point for Ethiopia's National Academic OER and Digital Library with access to all collections and services
- [Browse Interface](https://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/browse): Discover academic content across all institutional repositories and collections in NADL Ethiopia
- [Communities and Collections](https://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/community-list): Directory of academic communities and curated collections organized by institution and discipline

## Global Learning Integrations

- [MIT OpenCourseWare](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/mit.jsp): Integration with MIT OCW for engineering and computer science courses
- [EdX Platform](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/edx.jsp): Access to EdX online courses and free educational content across multiple disciplines
- [Microsoft Learning Tools](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/microsoft.jsp): Microsoft STEM and K-12 coding education resources integrated into the platform

## Academic Course Materials

- [Undergraduate Course Collection](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/handle/123456789/87337): Undergraduate course materials from multiple college departments across various disciplines
- [Postgraduate Course Materials](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/handle/123456789/87346): Advanced course materials in biotechnology, communications, and specialized postgraduate programs
- [Institute of Water Technology Resources](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/handle/123456789/78232): University course materials from the Institute of Water Technology

## Vocational and Technical Training

- [Federal TVET Materials](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/handle/123456789/78230): Vocational training materials and curriculum from Federal TVET Institution for technical skills development
- [Health Professional Training](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/handle/123456789/78227): Health professional training resources covering immunization, COVID-19, and clinical education

## Disciplinary Resources

- [Chemistry, Accounting, and Architecture Resources](http://ndl.ethernet.edu.et/handle/123456789/79572): Digital item records containing specialized resources in chemistry, accounting, and architecture disciplines
